notes: Average 4.00 (4/4/4/4/4/4/4). This meets the bar (avg >= 4.0, nothing below 3), but only just. Signature is the weakest 4. It went up from 3 because three of critic-3's four drawing defects are fixed and the fourth is half fixed. Two new one-word failures keep it from being a firm 4. All gates pass on all four apps (eval-4.md; palette 0.802, type 0.811). Not counted: the invisible working glyph (harness gap); the sticky header painted mid-page (blog state-search-empty, state-newsletter-success; dashboard state-empty-filter); the dialog scrim ending at 900px (settings state-plan-dialog); title-case post and product names (test-pinned). The empty 'On this page' rail on blog posts-release-notes-people-read-desktop-light is a capture taken mid-transition: the same page in desktop-dark lists all four headings. Not counted.

Critic-3 issues, one by one. FIXED, defect A (mitten hands), for the Present pose. Fingers are now long, separate hairpins with visible gaps and varied lengths. They stand next to reference/motion/p7-v1.png: blog drawings/home-d7 (jar, hand from the left), home-d9 (book header); commerce home-d10 fingers, cart-d1 (wallet); settings settings-billing-d2 (Free plan). No ticks, no balls of fingers. FIXED, stamped pose. Hands enter from the bottom, the top, the left and the right, in Present, Grip, Pinch and side-grip poses. The three plan drawings now differ: Present, pen in a pinch, briefcase gripped from the top (settings-billing-d2..d4). FIXED, defect B (monoline). Large strokes swell and thin to points at their ends: blog home-d2 (fan ribs), posts-release-notes-people-read-d1 (megaphone rim), commerce products-canvas-field-tote-d2, products-merino-crew-sweater-d1. They are close to reference/illustrations/p15-i1.png, with no shoulders or notches at native size. FIXED, defect C (plate clipping). Every object sits inside its plate. The flag, megaphone, jar and beanie clear the top edge (blog home-d3..d7; commerce home-d11). Only wrists leave, through the edge the hand enters from: bell and towels from the top, skillet from the bottom, mug from the right. The tote detail stage anchors wrist-top and its forearm leaves the top edge (products-canvas-field-tote-d1). PARTLY FIXED, defect D (silhouettes). The beanie now stands alone and reads as a beanie (commerce home-d11). The towels show stripes and a hanging loop, not a can (home-d9). The megaphone handle is attached under the cone (blog home-d5). New failures are listed under Signature. FIXED, frame counts. Every header runs steps(9) in 747ms at 48px (commerce, dashboard, settings motion-m1). The blog's 96px masthead runs steps(17) in 1411ms (motion-m2). Counts are consistent across apps, never padded, never blank, and they hold. FIXED, empty band on wide stages. The article stage is 4:3 and capped, with the drawing centred (posts-shipping-a-design-system-d1). FIXED, stray mark from a neighbouring frame (dashboard state-empty-filter-desktop-light binoculars are clean). FIXED, cross-app: product detail has a header drawing (commerce products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-light, merino sweater). FIXED, polish: the about page no longer mixes a centred prose h2 with a left list h2 (about-desktop-light). Its new left alignment goes against the spec; see Signature. UNCHANGED: the settings invoice column spread (see Spacing).

Regressions since critic-3: none of weight. The previous run's settings hand count is now 4 of 8 drawings (agent-report), which meets the half rule. Commerce dropped hands from its 48px headers because they read as 'a fish tail and a fork' (agent-report). It moved them to plates, which the spec allows.

Signature 4 (was 3). All five elements are in all four apps and placed per Applying the concept. Every product screen has a written-in h1 beside a pictoSm, product detail included. The dashboard chart sits on a sage stage. Plans sit on a lilac stage and stack fully at 390px (settings-billing-mobile-light). Drawing stages hold the featured post, articles and product detail. Plates hold each item's own drawing, and an item keeps its plate colour on every screen. Motion steps once and holds. What keeps it at a weak 4:

Signature, weakness 1: two drawings fail the one-word test, which the spec now applies to every drawing (recipe step 5). (a) The blog's featured 'colour-swatch fan' reads as a scallop shell (blog drawings/home-d2, posts-shipping-a-design-system-d3; also on the related-post plate in posts-release-notes-people-read-desktop-light). The ribs radiate from a ring-like rivet, under one flat fill, with a scalloped top edge. Nothing says 'swatches': the blades don't separate and there is no second tone. The agent noticed the problem and only tilted it (agent-report: 'tilted so it doesn't read as a shell'). This is the largest drawing on the blog, and it appears on three screens. (b) Leather Key Ring reads as a creature (commerce drawings/home-d10, home-desktop-light, home-mobile-dark). The key's round bow plus the elongated leather loop above it make a rabbit's head with one ear. The long thumb stroke falling to the bottom left reads as its neck. The Never list forbids a drawing that names a creature. The reference's small objects have no such double reading: reference/illustrations/p3-i1.png (hanger), p3-i2.png (toolbox), p6-i7.png (square in a hand).

Signature, weakness 2: side-grip fingers are built worse than the reference's. Stacked parallel fingers in a side grip ARE in the reference (reference/illustrations/p10-i5.png: two hands from the sides, four tightly stacked fingers each), so stacking is not marked down. The reference builds each finger as a hairpin loop with a rounded tip that curls round the object, inside a squared back-of-hand outline. The app's bell grip draws five single straight strokes ending flush at the rope, with no tips (blog drawings/home-d8). The flag grip's four strokes cross the pole without wrapping it (home-d4). Both read nearer to a coil spring than p10-i5 does. The commerce mug (home-d7) is the good case: four hairpins with an index finger hooked through the handle, close to p10-i5's right hand. The spec says Grip fingers are 'fanned 8 to 12 degrees, never parallel rungs', but it has no demo for that pose. Only Present has one (leafOnHand), so every Grip is improvised. The spec's 'never parallel' also contradicts p10-i5.

Signature, weakness 3, minor: the about page's prose opener is left-aligned (blog about-desktop-light, agent-report: 'left-aligned rather than centred'). Applying the concept says 'Prose: centered size.pictoLg drawing', as in the reference's section openers (reference/screenshots/p3-desktop-light.png: centred pictogram over a centred h2). The left version reads as a list section that happens to have a drawing.

Reference fidelity 4. Someone who knows the reference recognizes it without it being a copy: cream paper and warm ink; a text serif over a quiet sans; ink, ring and stone controls; pastel stages crossed by faint wandering lines; a raised chart on a sage stage; plan cards with small drawings on a lilac stage; cel drawings that step in stroke by stroke and hold (compare reference/motion/p7-v1.png with blog motion-m2). The hands now resemble the reference's hands. It is held at 4, not 5, by the drawing weaknesses scored under Signature. There are no reference subjects, names or burst marks.

Hierarchy 4. Every screen leads with the serif h1 and its drawing, then one stage or main card. The featured drawing sits under the masthead h1 in weight (blog home-desktop-light). Plan cards with full-width ink buttons match the reference's plan row (reference p3-desktop-light), so they are not marked down. Minor: dashboard project detail (projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light) and settings Profile, Notifications and Security are one raised card under the header. The spec allows that; not marked down.

Spacing 4. The header grid, panel gaps, form rhythm and stage padding are consistent across apps. Stat cards are 2x2 at 390px. Minor, unchanged: in the settings invoices table at 1440px, about 320px of empty space sits between Date and Amount and about 170px trails after Status (settings-billing-desktop-light). The spec has no rule for distributing columns. Minor: the commerce Checkout card has about 24px from its title to the first label, while the Items card next to it has about 40px (state-checkout-errors-desktop-light).

States 4. Designed everywhere: clay focus rings (dashboard state-keyboard-focus Search button; blog state-search-empty field; settings state-password-mismatch); card hover with shadow and title underline (commerce state-card-hover); danger rings, inline messages and an 'N fields need attention' line (commerce state-checkout-errors, settings state-profile-errors-mobile-light); a dialog with a serif title and secondary + primary actions (settings state-plan-dialog); filtered-empty states with a drawing, a title and one clear action (blog state-search-empty, dashboard state-empty-filter); a check-circle success line with a pictoLg mailbox (blog state-newsletter-success); a strength dot; a disabled stepper minus. Minor: in dark mode the off switch's thumb (surface.raised #262624) almost disappears on its track (surface.subtle #1f1e1d). The off rows show an empty-looking pill (settings settings-notifications-desktop-dark: Weekly summary, Comments, Reminders). This is a spec gap. Minor: 'Current plan' is an outline box at button height with 13px secondary text, while the neighbouring buttons use 15px medium labels (settings-billing-desktop-light). It sits between the spec's badge and its disabled button and matches neither.

Polish 4. No default-browser leftovers and no generic look in the captures. Kept at 4 by small alignment slips: the dashboard projects table's BUDGET header ends about 17px left of its right-aligned cells, while DUE DATE lines up with its cells (projects-desktop-light, home-desktop-light). The spec says a header cell aligns like its cells. Also the invoice column spread (see Spacing).

Cross-app 4. One family: paper and ink, serif h1s beside 48px drawings that step in over the same 9 frames, ring controls, stone chips with an ink selected chip, outline status badges with dots, 16px cards, clay focus, a warm dark mode with dimmed pastels (blog home-desktop-dark, commerce home-mobile-dark, dashboard team-desktop-dark, settings settings-notifications-desktop-dark). Every product screen, store detail included, now has a header drawing. Drift, minor: a bell is used in three apps for three meanings: a blog plate (Notes From a Month Without Chat Notifications), dashboard Team, settings Notifications. Team as a bell fails the spirit of recipe step 1 ('names this app's domain').
promptFixes: Signature, Grip construction (spec gap; Hands). Add a second demo next to leafOnHand: a side grip measured on reference/illustrations/p10-i5.png. A squared back-of-hand outline (2 to 3 bowed strokes) leaves through the side edge. Then 4 `finger()` hairpins (lengths 22, 24, 21, 16), bases 6 to 7 units apart on a vertical knuckle line, each tip curling 90 to 120 degrees round the far side of the held object, so the rounded tips show past it. Replace 'fanned 8 to 12 degrees, never parallel rungs' with 'stacked side-grip fingers may run parallel (reference p10-i5) but each is a hairpin loop whose rounded tip wraps the object; never single straight strokes, never ending flush at a pole or rope'. Add to Verification: 'Every gripping finger has a visible loop tip at its rendered size.'

Signature, one-word test for metaphor subjects (strengthen recipe step 5; the agent saw the failure and kept it). Add: 'If the word you get is a natural thing (shell, leaf, flower, creature) and the subject is man-made, add what only the made thing has (a rivet and separate blades with two fill tones for a swatch fan; teeth and a bit for a key) or pick another subject. Tilting is not a fix.' Add to the Never list's creature item: 'two round shapes stacked with a stroke below them (head, ear, neck)'. Name the failure seen: 'a key ring drawn as a ring plus an oval loop reads as a rabbit: draw the key's toothed blade largest and the loop as a flat strap.'

Signature, prose opener alignment (agent deviation the spec already forbids; make it explicit). Add to Spacing and density, Section opener: 'Prose sections are centred: drawing, h2, lede and actions on one centre axis, max size.measure (reference p3 section openers). List sections stay left. Never a left-aligned drawing over a prose h2.' Add this to Verification's per-screen list.

Component states, dark switch thumb (spec gap; Switch). The off thumb `color.surface.raised` on track `color.surface.subtle` is about 1.1:1 in dark mode (settings-notifications-desktop-dark). Change Switch Anatomy to: 'Thumb off: `color.border.check` (light and dark); on: `color.text.onAction`.' Add to Accessibility: 'A switch thumb is at least 3:1 against its track in both schemes.'

Component states, plan state marker (spec ambiguity; Card, plan variant). Add: 'The current plan's action slot holds a Status badge (outline, check-circle, "Current plan") centred at size.control height, or a disabled button styled per Button Disabled, never an outline box with small text.' Settings currently mixes the two (settings-billing-desktop-light).

Polish, sortable numeric headers (strengthen Table). Add: 'A sortable numeric header is a right-aligned button whose arrow sits before the label, so the label's right edge meets the cells' right edge. Reserve no trailing arrow space.' Add to Verification: 'Every numeric header's text ends on its cells' right edge.' (dashboard projects-desktop-light BUDGET.)

Cross-app, subject reuse (recipe step 1). Add: 'Prefer a subject the family has not used: a bell, flag or clipboard already used by another screen of the same kind is a last resort. A team or people screen draws something people share (a table, a bench, a relay baton), not an alert object.'

Spacing, table column distribution (carried over; Table). Add: 'With fewer than 5 columns at 1440px, give the first column 30 to 40%, numbers and status `width:1%; white-space:nowrap`, and let text columns take the rest; no gap between columns over 200px.'

Harness notes (not prompt fixes; carried over). (a) pigment-snap needs a --reduced-motion flag; agents still report they cannot review as the spec asks. (b) Add a mocked-network capture state per base app, so the working glyph can be judged. (c) Capture sticky headers, sidebars and dialog scrims per viewport. (d) Wait for disclosure transitions to settle before the full-page capture: blog posts-release-notes-people-read-desktop-light caught the contents rail at opacity 0.
